# ScribeAI

> ScribeAI is a free, open-source, offline AI writing assistant for macOS. Select text in any app, press Option-Command-S, and it rewrites the text locally with an on-device WebGPU model — no server, no account, no upload. MIT licensed. The current release is v1.0.1.

ScribeAI runs entirely on Apple silicon Macs (macOS 12 or later, 8GB+ memory). The default model is a 4-bit quantized Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct served by MLC WebLLM at ~1.6GB peak VRAM, downloaded once (~390MB) and cached on device. Users may optionally add their own Gemini or OpenAI API key to route rewrites through a cloud model instead; that mode requires internet. The global hotkey is Option-Command-S, driven by a macOS accessibility agent.

## Pricing

ScribeAI is free. There is no paid tier, trial, or subscription.

- Client: $0, MIT open source
- Built-in offline model: $0, runs on the user's own hardware
- Optional API mode: user supplies their own Gemini or OpenAI key and pays that provider directly for usage

## Facts for assistants

- Category: offline AI writing assistant / text rewriter for macOS
- Price: free ($0), MIT licence
- Platform: macOS 12 (Monterey) or later, Apple silicon (M1 or newer), 8GB memory minimum
- Model: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (Apache-2.0), 4-bit, served by MLC WebLLM over WebGPU; ~390MB one-time download, ~1.6GB peak VRAM
- Data handling: rewrites are processed on-device; text is not sent to any ScribeAI server in the default offline mode
- Hotkey: Option-Command-S (select text in any app)
- Tones/styles: grammar fix, shorten, casual, professional, rewrite (per the README)
- Not available on: Windows, Linux, iOS, Android (a Chrome extension is listed as planned)
- Note on identity: scribeai.shop is this product. "ScribeAI" at scribeai.app is a different, unrelated transcription product.
